name: AWS Access Key ID
match_guidance: AKIA/ASIA-style access-key identifier; require key context or known prefix to reduce false positives.

name: AWS Secret Access Key
match_guidance: Secret-key assignment with AWS context and high-entropy 40-character base64-like value; do not flag variable references.

name: Azure Client Secret
match_guidance: ClientSecret/AZURE_CLIENT_SECRET context with a non-placeholder value.

name: GCP Service Account JSON key
match_guidance: Service-account object with type=service_account and private_key/private_key_id fields; parse JSON and PEM marker context.

name: Private key material
match_guidance: Recognize private-key BEGIN/END labels and plausible encoded body; do not alert on PUBLIC KEY certificates.

name: GitHub classic token
match_guidance: ghp_ prefix and expected token-like suffix; ignore documented placeholder strings.

name: GitHub fine-grained token
match_guidance: github_pat_ prefix and expected token-like suffix; require token context.

name: GitLab personal/project token
match_guidance: glpat- prefix and expected token-like suffix; support other configured GitLab token prefixes where applicable.

name: Slack token
match_guidance: Recognize xoxb-/xoxp-/xoxs-/xoxa- token families with plausible structure.

name: Stripe secret key
match_guidance: sk_live_ and restricted-key variants; include test-key prefix variants as a separate lower-severity context if supported.

name: OpenAI API key
match_guidance: Recognize current sk-proj-/sk-svcacct- formats and legacy sk- patterns while excluding known examples/placeholders.

name: Anthropic API key
match_guidance: Recognize sk-ant- family and plausible suffix; ignore obvious synthetic placeholders if configured as allowlisted.

name: JSON Web Token (JWT)
match_guidance: Parse three base64url segments; validate header/payload JSON and report only token-shaped values in sensitive contexts.

name: Hardcoded password
match_guidance: Password/secret assignments with literal non-placeholder values; suppress examples, empty strings, environment references, and common placeholders.
